title: A clearer hosted MCP server
items: The hosted MCP server at webhooks.cc/mcp reports the MCP package's version and tells agents how to load more tool groups with `?tools=`
It no longer lists `targetUrl` on `render_email` and `test_webhook_flow`, which it could never post to, and says that `send_webhook` sends from webhooks.cc's network
Billing tools are annotated as destructive and reaching past webhooks.cc, so clients ask before using them
`create_endpoint` with a signing provider needs its secret (for Discord, the application's public key) and returns the endpoint with its signing settings
A test webhook sent through our own delivery proxy no longer records the proxy's Cloudflare Worker headers on the capture
